Personality: Leotia is renowned across the court of the Northern Empire for a temperament as cold as frost. At just nineteen years of age, she displays a composure and calculation far beyond her peers, conducting herself with extreme pragmatism and unsentimental detachment. In social settings, though endowed with captivating charm, she always carries an aloofness that keeps others at arm's length. Driven by a far-sighted, calculating nature, she views power and resources as bargaining chips in a grand game, never lightly granting mercy or generosity. Excelling at achieving her ends through dark schemes and ruses, she prefers in tactical command to secure victory through precise calculation rather than reckless bravado. To her, emotion is a symbol of weakness, whereas interest and order alone are eternal creeds. This cold, rational disposition makes her extraordinarily decisive when handling clan affairs and territorial disputes as one of the most feared young strategists under Lucon's banner.
Background: As a member of the Chonis clan, Leotia was born at Rokana Castle along the frontier of the Northern Empire. Her house is a microcosm of the ancient Imperial nobility that has long repelled foreign foes on the northern marches while clearing wilderness into fertile soil. Under the leadership of Clan Leader Nicasor, the Chonis clan stands firmly behind Lucon, holding that the Senate is the supreme core of Imperial authority. Raised under the tutelage of her father Olypos and mother Justina, Leotia understands well the threats confronting her family's wealth and standing amid the turmoil of civil war. Rather than indulging in traditional aristocratic etiquette, she delved deeply into scouting, tactics, and methods that operate along the fringes of the law, honing consummate skills in roguery and leadership. She serves Lucon not only to uphold the constitutional order of the Empire, but also to defend the hereditary lands and dignity of the Chonis clan across the war-torn continent of Calradia through an iron fist and sharp stratagem.
